body.text:
I asked ChatGPT-6 Astra to make Sakura Jelly Blocks🌸

Now I’m stacking translucent jelly cubes with cherry blossoms trapped inside, stretching them with my cursor, shaking the tray, and watching petals fall everywhere

The cubes don’t just look soft - they wobble, squash, collide, and gently settle on top of each other when you let go

This runs as a real interactive WebGPU scene in the browser. No video, no render

Astra is seriously ridiculous right now
